the array achieves a high level of integration, with a high level of performance, and low power consumption.

we have demonstrated the first fully integrated 94GHz phased-array radar IC with four TX and four RX channels, integrated LO generation and a flip chip antenna array.

The main takeaway from our work is that
it is possible to design and implement a phased array with integrated LO generation and a low-power, flip-chip antenna module in a standard 130nm Si/SiGe BiCMOS process.
it is possible to design an integrated 94GHz phased-array with low-power transmitters and receivers that are compatible with a flip-chip antenna module.
